content.short: Shadow Exchange is a concentrated liquidity layer and exchange built on the Sonic network.
content.description: Shadow Exchange builds on the ve(3,3) governance idea popularized by Andre Cronje, aiming to align user incentives around long‑term participation. Yet the original design left an exit gap: users could be locked for extended periods, creating friction and compelling token locking to participate fairly in the incentive system. Shadow Exchange reimagines that design with xSHADOW, a mechanism that broadens access to incentives by removing four‑year lockups and adding explicit exit options, with the goal of making participation more equitable while preserving the underlying alignment principles.
